question: Two protons are projected towards each other with equal speeds from infinity. Analyze the energy transformation at the distance of closest approach.

options.A: Entire Initial Kinetic Energy is converted to Electrostatic Potential Energy.
options.B: Half of the Kinetic Energy is converted to Potential Energy.
options.C: Kinetic Energy is maximum and Potential Energy is zero.
